h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Purnia

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Purnia

c: Purnia is the main town of Bihar's Seemanchal region, in the flat Kosi plain near the borders with West Bengal and Nepal, and maize and jute farming support much of the district. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Purnia for schools, colleges, government colonies, hospital campuses and the municipal corporation's parks. We build every machine at our Vasai factory, about 1660 km away.

Orders reach north-east Bihar by road, and a dealer from our eastern India network or our own team installs them. The Kosi plain gets a heavy monsoon, and flooding is common in the wider district. Summers are humid and winters are cold. We look closely at drainage in your site photos and set each machine on a raised base, so the gym is usable again soon after the water drains.

items.q: What should we do if floodwater reaches the machines?
items.a: Once the water drains, rinse mud and silt off the frames and footings, check that each machine is firm and grease the moving parts. Call our after-sales team if anything is damaged.

items.q: Can a hospital campus in Purnia add an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. A few gentle machines along a garden path suit staff and visitors. Share the site plan and photos, and we send a layout drawing for your approval.

items.q: Do you deliver outdoor gym equipment to Seemanchal?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from Vasai by road to Purnia and nearby towns, and installation is done by our team or an eastern India dealer, grouted or self-standing as the ground needs.
